description: This file defines a Python module for interfacing with the OpenAI API, including configuration, client initialization, and chat completion methods.

classes.name: _Config
classes.description: Internal configuration model for OpenAI client, holding API key and model name.

classes.name: _OpenAIClientWrapper
classes.description: Encapsulates OpenAI client initialization, configuration, and chat completion calls.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the OpenAI client wrapper, reading configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: _is_available
methods.description: Checks if the API key is available for use.

methods.name: is_configured
methods.description: Checks if the client is properly configured and ready to use.

methods.name: get_model
methods.description: Returns the name of the selected OpenAI model.

methods.name: create_chat_completion
methods.description: Creates a chat completion using the OpenAI API and returns the assistant's reply.
